title: NATO European Members Boost Defence Spending for 12th Consecutive Year
detail: NATO European member states have increased defence spending for the 12th consecutive year, marking a sustained and record-level commitment to Alliance burden-sharing. The milestone underscores the long-running trend of European allies expanding defence budgets that accelerated sharply after Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, with all 32 allies now meeting the 2% GDP target for the first time in NATO history.

title: Bipartisan 'NATO Shield' Bill Would Constrain US Withdrawal From Alliance
detail: Reps. Jimmy Panetta (D) and Joe Wilson (R), who introduced the NATO Shield Act on Sept 24, are pressing it as Russian gray-zone pressure on the Baltics and Poland grows. It would require the president to consult Congress 72 hours before any NATO withdrawal and file a report on the legal basis and consequences. A withdrawal would lapse after 30 days unless Congress approves it, and unapproved withdrawals could not be funded.

media.caption: RFE/RL: As Russia Tests Western Alliance, US Lawmakers Push 'NATO Shield' Bill
